name: sales-lead-to-close
description: Sales motion: qualify an inbound lead, then ROUTE by deal size to the right play. An SDR runs BANT; a router reads the qualification and sends enterprise deals down a proposal + legal pre-check path, mid-market to a straight proposal, and everything unqualified to a nurture touch. Showcases `route` with per-branch depth (a branch can itself be a multi-phase sequence).

inputs.name: lead
inputs.description: The inbound lead — who they are, their company, and what they asked for (paste the form / email / call notes).

phases.name: qualify
route-by-deal-size
phases.description: Enterprise → full proposal + a legal pre-check before it goes out. Mid → straight proposal. Anything unqualified → nurture, not a forced proposal.

phases.name: enterprise-proposal
legal-pre-check

mid.name: mid-market-proposal

default.name: nurture
